$comment: Platform preference (card xx0055i). fix.roundCapAction person|takeover: at the fix round cap, takeover = dispatch ONE takeover fix (full round history, top claude rung of the fixer ladder) before asking the operator; person = ask the operator at once (tool override env WE_FIX_ROUND_CAP_ACTION). fix.roundHistory on|off: a round N>1 fix brief carries the previous-rounds section (env WE_FIX_ROUND_HISTORY). fix.takeoverMaxPerPr: how many takeovers one PR may get, 0 turns the takeover off (env WE_FIX_TAKEOVER_MAX_PER_PR). Ruling disputes always go to the operator. Card xrbu1bp: fix.resumeAcrossRounds on|off: round N>1 resumes the previous round's fixer session when it is still resumable and its lane is still at the PR head (else a cold start with the history brief; env WE_FIX_RESUME_ACROSS_ROUNDS). fix.strongerModelFromRound: from this round an ordinary fix runs on the fixer ladder's stronger-model rung, 0 = off (env WE_FIX_STRONGER_MODEL_FROM_ROUND). See scripts/conveyor/fix-takeover.mjs, scripts/conveyor/fix-round-history.mjs and scripts/conveyor/fix-resume.mjs.
